verdicts.reason: A is a clean left-to-right banner, but the earbud case is shrunk to a small icon on the far left. The logo floats alone at the top centre, a loose gap separates the headline from the price line, and the canvas is mostly empty dark space. B gives the product real weight and groups logo, headline and price into one tight block, so it is more balanced and closer to the original. Its flaws: the headline and the price line (about 9px) are small and weak next to the oversized product, and the CTA sits slightly higher than the text block.
